commands.notes: Share-sheet and paste URL intake must use the steward-approved importSourceLink command. Runtime routing, provider lookup, queue persistence, and item creation remain steward-owned backend requests.
Only exposed after importSourceLink resolves a public RSS/audio-backed podcast link into a persisted transcript_backed_media item.

backendRequests.title: Route share-sheet and pasted URLs into importSourceLink
backendRequests.details: Add app/share-extension URL intake that creates a LinkResolutionRequest for public podcast links and calls the canonical importSourceLink path without introducing resolveLink, importPodcastURL, or any other command id.

backendRequests.title: Resolve public podcast links to RSS/audio candidates
backendRequests.details: Implement provider-independent lookup for public podcast episode pages and feed links, selecting only candidates with public RSS/audio enclosure URLs. Exclusive/private provider links should return unsupported or needs_review without fabricated playable audio.

backendRequests.title: Publish link resolution queue snapshot fields
backendRequests.details: Surface linkResolutionStatus and linkResolutionFailureReason in canonical snapshots for resolving, playable, needs_review, and unsupported queue states. These fields are accepted vocabulary but are backend-request runtime output.

backendRequests.title: Persist resolved podcast items and remote-stream audio
backendRequests.details: When a public link resolves to a playable audio enclosure, persist an Item with mediaType transcript_backed_media and an AudioRepresentation with sourceType remote_stream. Queue state should retain the original SourceLink and selected candidate for review/debugging.

notes: Track B does not add executable traces; link-resolution events are not replayable trace language until steward runtime and harness support exists.
Public RSS/audio-backed podcast acquisitions produce transcript_backed_media items and remote_stream audio representations.
linkResolutionStatus and linkResolutionFailureReason are referenced only as backend-request snapshot fields.
